## Benchmarking JSONStorage read speed (2026-11-03)

The owner suspected that JSONStorage re-parses the whole file on every query. They asked for a benchmark script under scripts/ that builds a roughly 40MB db and times db.all() and a search, so the cost is measured and not guessed.

Memory holds one observation of work so far. An initial read of tinydb/storages.py found that JSONStorage re-reads and fully parses the db file on each table read path. That matches the owner's hypothesis. No benchmark script, timings or write-up have been recorded yet.

## What this shows so far

The request is at the exploration stage, so there is no rework, stall or release to learn from. One working preference is already visible: the owner wants numbers before any change is made to fix a performance suspicion.
